WHAT NARROWS IT (all = perl on s543h's tree): the plain spelling `local $v` in the same eval (c-01); the brace spelling outside an eval, `package Bar; ... local ${v}` (c-02); the eval without the `package` (c-03); the eval + package with NO `our` at the site (c-05, c-06).  So: the eval site's `our` alias (s543h's `our:` site input) reaches the READ of a brace-spelled name and not the `local` statement's target for the same spelling.

FIX DIRECTION: one resolver (CLAUDE.md "A detector, its rewriter and its promoter share ONE resolver"): the `local` plan's target (`_local_var_cl` and the plan s543g wrote) must take a brace-spelled name through the same site-input lookup as `_rewrite_var_uses` / `_brace_name_refs`.  Probe the three sigils and an element (`local ${h}{k}` is #5372 -- it dies before it gets here).
